tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find a home in Slovakia — a flat, house, cottage or building plot for sale or for rent — by type, rooms, place (town, Bratislava/Košice borough, district or region), price, area, floor, condition or amenities (balcony, lift, parking, cellar). Covers listings agencies

tools.name: get_property_details
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for more about one specific property returned by search_properties (floor, number of floors, condition, construction, ownership, energy certificate, year built, balcony, lift, parking, cellar, price history). Requires the property id from search_properties; do not guess i

tools.name: get_price_per_m2
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how much property costs per m² in a Slovak town, borough or district, or whether a price per m² is reasonable there. Returns the median ASKING price per m² of comparable listings in LivinIsto's current offer (the same figure as LivinIsto's price estimate), the sample size
